verdict.rationale: Kit documents a dedicated bulk and async processing API. It covers bulk subscriber creation, bulk custom-field creation and bulk custom-field value updates across many subscribers in one request, and large batches run asynchronously with a callback_url. A broadcast-stats endpoint also returns a whole page of broadcasts in a single request. Bulk support is limited to "some common use cases" and requires OAuth. missing for 10: bulk coverage across all resource types (e.g. tags, broadcasts), evidence that the Kit MCP exposes bulk actions to AI clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: We support bulk processing for some common use cases, e.g. create subscribers, requiring OAuth authentication.
For large batch sizes, we use an asynchronous callback design. If you include a `callback_url` in your request body, we'll `POST` to that URL when our processing has completed.
Creates or updates custom field values for many subscribers in one request.
for a page of broadcasts in a single request, avoiding a call per broadcast.
